{{Quote|Things don't always turn out the way you may wish they do. That's life, I suppose.|Tyla Jinn, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MD" />}}
'''Tyla Jinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Can you help me? Please help me! My friend's ship is missing and I haven't heard from him. I'm really worried.|Tyla Jinn, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MD" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tyla Jinn lived in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], on Naboo.<ref name="SWG:MD" /> She was an underworld figure who frequented the [[Theed Cantina]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|165|Jinn, Tyla}}</ref> At some point, she was almost arrested for pestering an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]].<ref name="SWG:MD" />

[[File:Cal_Handro_crashed_ship.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Cal Handro]]'s crashed ship on Rori.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one of her close friends, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cal Handro]], was shot down above Naboo's moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG:MD" /> The pilot was transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] when he was attacked and crash-landed on the moon.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> Tyla Jinn, who claimed she ignored everything about the illegal activities of her friend, recruited a group of spacers to rescue the pilot. It appeared that the man had survived the crash but he had vanished in the wilderness. The spacers successfully localized the crash site of Cal Handro's ship, in the [[Madyn Plains]] of Rori, but did not find any trace of the smuggler, only [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] henchmen also looking for the missing pilot. The spacers managed to collect Handro's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a sample of spice and brought it back to Tyla Jinn. The woman then requested the spacer to bring the spice to her cousin, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Edvar Vang]], for analysis, though the cousins were not on good terms. In fact, Vang already knew the existence of that spice but he was too afraid to provide any information. He suggested the spacers to meet his friend [[Moxxar Krieg]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] but the latter was found murdered at [[Moxxar Krieg's house|his place]]. In the meantime, spacers working for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and Rebel officers [[Jevan Monsul]] and [[Veega Madish]] also searched for the missing pilot on Rori.<ref name="SWG:MD" />

[[File:BlackSunBase.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Black Sun bunker]] on Rori.]]
A short time later, a woman by the name [[Kaila Min]], a regular at the Gambling Hall in [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]], contacted Tyla Jinn and pretended she saw Cal Handro in the wilderness of Rori. The spacers rushed to the pilot's last known location, only to be attacked by Black Sun minions. From their attackers, they obtained the location of the [[Black Sun bunker|Black Sun base]] on Rori. The spacers then raided the base but did not find Handro there.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

Tyla Jinn later learnt that Cal Handro had met the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Wire]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. The Bothan informed the spacers that the smuggler was wanted dead by [[Trussk]], a slavemaster of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] who considered that Handro was interfering in their business by shipping [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for a rival [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] clan. The spacers then assaulted [[Trussk's house|Trussk's fortress]] on Naboo but, again, they did not find Handro.<ref name="SWG:Gc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Getting closer?"</ref>

[[File:MartanoEstate2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Black Sun enforcers besieging the Martano estate.]]
Finally, Cal Handro was localized at the [[Martano estate]], on Rori. Tyla Jinn tasked the spacers to encounter the wealthy gambler [[Tierce Martano]] to confirm that the missing pilot was safe. However, when they arrived at the estate, the place was besieged by Black Sun enforcers. While the spacers attacked the criminals, Martano sent a distress alert to both the Empire and the Rebel Alliance because he knew that both were also looking for Handro. The adventurers finally managed to kill all Black Sun forces and met Tierce Martano. As the gambler wished to get rid of Handro as soon as possible, he eagerly accepted to give the location of Handro to the spacers. Furthermore, they learnt from Martano that the Empire and the Rebellion were now on their traces and would probably find Handro soon. At that point, the spacers decided to stop following Tyla Jinn's orders and continued tracking the smuggler by joining one of the two factions.<ref name="SWG:WYG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Within Your Grasp"</ref> Cal Handro was eventually killed in his [[Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser|starship]] during a space battle between Imperial and Rebel forces in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Alliance!"</ref><ref name="SWG:FtE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Empire!"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanFemale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Tyla Jinn]]
Tyla Jinn was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:MD" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tyla Jinn was added to the game with the first chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 14 Notes for 9 March 05|Publish 14]]," on [[March 9]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=730|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

Tyla Jinn's appearance was randomly generated, but she always appeared as a Human female.<ref name="SWG:MD" />
